{{Top|leg}}
A '''flash pistol''' was a weapon used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exocron]]. Instead of firing a projectile or [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt, the flash pistol created a burst of light that could be used to temporarily blind a target.
